independent_recomputation.note: recompute_value reads pool_class and parameters only; the cached value field is never an input to the 400-digit verification

pool_crosscheck.method: head terms plus a Hurwitz-zeta tail expansion -- no digamma, no partial fractions, a different truncation argument

precision_artifact.construction: x = alternating_shift:p2:a-1:b-1 + 2*alternating_shift:p2:a-1:b-3 + 1e-260, which satisfies x - a - 2b = 0 to 260 digits and fails it at 400

random_false_relation.note: absence is bounded: no relation with coefficients under the declared bound, never a proof that none exists

corpus.note: a corpus hit is decimal agreement of the stored value to 50 digits; absence from a finite corpus establishes nothing about the literature

score_definition.per_member: corpus_value_hits (integer) and reduces_to_classical_basis, which is true when EITHER a bounded PSLQ against the declared 10-constant basis finds a relation that survives 400 digits, OR a declared theorem supplies a closed form outside that span (class-number-one Epstein factorisation; Gauss's digamma theorem when every root is rational)
score_definition.per_region: reduction_fraction = reduced/members, both integers printed in the row so the number is reproducible by hand from this receipt
score_definition.sparse_rule: a region is SPARSE when reduction_fraction <= 1/10; a member is a sparse-region member when its region is SPARSE, it does not itself reduce, and it has zero corpus value hits

cause: targets were the classical constants, whose neighbourhoods are the most heavily mined in mathematics
the proof step was circular: the reduction techniques ARE the classical families, so anything provable was thereby classical
the grammar was a curated list of families named because they were fruitful
fix: Component 1 generates its own targets from declared definitions
Component 2 measures where the corpus and the classical basis are thin
Component 3 hunts only there, and treats failure to reduce as the signal
diagnosis.prior_campaigns: 1.19e8 continued-fraction ordinals and 3.25e9 series/product/integral ordinals returned zero new results

headline.reading: a surviving relation is true to 400 digits and untouched by the declared classical ladder. It is UNREVIEWED, not new. Absence from the corpus establishes nothing, and every entry needs a human with a literature search.

config.cf_shape_selection: shape_index = (104729 + k * 7919) mod 531441, k = 0, 1, 2, ...; identity Moebius wrap
config.epstein_discriminants: every D in [-67, -3] with D = 0 or 1 mod 4
config.integral_selection: exponent-a grid index = (17 + k * 53) mod 360; exponent-b grid index = (131 + k * 97) mod 360; kernels cycled, powers cycled

error_bound_methods.cf_unmatched: depth-D against depth-2D convergents at dps+70; the two must agree to 1e-208
error_bound_methods.epstein_lattice: Ewald/incomplete-gamma split evaluated at two precisions and two truncation radii (1.0x and 1.3x); the two must agree to 1e-208
error_bound_methods.integral_off_locus: tanh-sinh in the log domain at dps+30 and dps+70; the two must agree to 1e-208
error_bound_methods.zeta_shift/alternating_shift/character_m: partial-fraction digamma closed form evaluated at dps+30 and dps+70; the two must agree to 1e-208 relative, and the imaginary residual (zero in exact arithmetic) is recorded
